def max_value(n, S, parcels):
    # Sort parcels by their out time
    parcels.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    
    # Initialize DP array
    dp = [[0 for _ in range(S + 1)] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    
    # Fill DP array
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(1, S + 1):
            # Skip the parcel
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j]
            
            # Consider putting the parcel on the platform
            weight, strength, value = parcels[i - 1][2], parcels[i - 1][3], parcels[i - 1][4]

                    if parcels[k][1] <= parcels[i - 1][0]:
                        dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j], dp[k][j - weight] + value)
                        break
    
    # Find the maximum value
    return max(dp[n])
